name: War Magic
summary: Battle wizards who blend evocation and abjuration.

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.short: Reaction: +2 AC or +4 to a save, then only cantrips next turn.
features.summary: When you are hit by an attack or fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain +2 AC against that attack or +4 to that save. Until the end of your next turn, you can only cast cantrips.

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.summary: You can give yourself a bonus to initiative rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Power Surge
features.short: Store power surges to add damage to spells.
features.summary: You can store power surges (max INT modifier; you start each long rest with one). You gain one when you end a spell with Dispel Magic or Counterspell. Once per turn, spend one to add half your wizard level as force damage to a spell's target.

features.name: Durable Magic
features.summary: While you maintain concentration on a spell, you have a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.short: Arcane Deflection also blasts up to three creatures.
features.summary: When you use Arcane Deflection, up to three creatures of your choice within 60 ft. take force damage equal to half your wizard level.
